A.notes: Site A delivers a stunning, editorial-quality design that perfectly captures the quiet, architectural mood requested. The SVG illustrations are intricate and beautifully constructed, and the typography is highly elegant. Motion is subtle and accessible fallbacks are handled flawlessly.

hard_gate_failures: Any animation without a reduced-motion path
B.notes: Site B has a functional structure but lacks the visual refinement and conceptual depth of the benchmark. The SVG illustrations are rudimentary, and the scroll-triggered line animations fail to render their final states when reduced motion is preferred, leaving key plan graphics completely blank.
